projectDescription: A self-hostable, Nostr-protocol workspace where humans and AI agents collaborate in shared channels, forums, DMs, and automated workflows.
keyFeatures: Self-hostable Nostr relay (NIP-01/NIP-29) as the single source of truth
Multi-tenant communities with proven isolation via TLA+ and Tamarin formal verification
AI agent integration via ACP harness supporting Goose, Codex, Claude Code, and MCP
YAML-as-code workflow engine with cron scheduling and expression evaluation
Desktop app (Tauri 2 + React 19) and mobile app (Flutter) clients
Git hosting backend with NIP-34 events, patch tracking, and PR-style review rooms
Full-text search across messages, patches, workflow runs, and audit logs
Blossom media (BUD-01/02) for file attachments and uploads
NIP-17 encrypted DMs with gift-wrap, presence and typing indicators
Push notifications via dedicated buzz-push-gateway with APNs support
buzz-cli: agent-first CLI for scripting relay interactions
Relay mesh (Iroh-based) for interconnecting multiple relay nodes
buzz-dev-mcp: MCP server for IDE integration
Kubernetes backend provider for remote agent execution (sprig)
publicApiSurface: buzz (CLI binary) — channels, messages, dms, agents, repos, patches, workflows, projects, issues, notes, feed, upload, moderation, users, reactions, emoji, mem, social, pack, pr
buzz-acp binary — ACP harness CLI bridging Buzz events to AI agent processes
buzz-sdk crate — typed Nostr event builders (builders.rs, mentions.rs, nip_oa.rs)
buzz_cli::run_from_args() — public Rust library entry point
Nostr kinds: KIND_STREAM_MESSAGE (9), KIND_JOB_REQUEST (43001), KIND_FORUM_POST (45001), KIND_WORKFLOW_* (46001-46012), KIND_PRESENCE_UPDATE (20001)
Environment variables: BUZZ_RELAY_URL, BUZZ_PRIVATE_KEY, BUZZ_AUTH_TAG, BUZZ_PUBKEY_ALLOWLIST, BUZZ_ADMIN_HOST, BUZZ_PUSH_GATEWAY_DELIVERY_URL
just tasks — setup, dev, relay, build, ci, test, reset, down, ps
